_comment: Named output presets for figures placed in slides and reports. A preset only fills in size, physical_height_cm and decoration_layout when the view (or defaults) does not set them; explicit values in the YAML always win. Heights are the physical height the image will have on the page, which render_map.py uses to size text, symbols and decorations.

slide._desc: 16:9 slide (19.05 cm / 7.5 in high): picture area = 2/3 of the slide height, leaving room for title and footer

slide_tall._desc: 16:9 slide (19.05 cm / 7.5 in high): picture area = 4/5 of the slide height, for slides with a short title

report_full._desc: Full-width A4 report figure (18 cm text width), 18 cm high

report_half._desc: Half-width report figure (about 8.5 cm wide, two-column layout), 10 cm high
